source.label: User-supplied compilation of156 public LP2 ideas
source.note: The compilation supplies no per-item source URLs. It is intake evidence, not a verified history of execution or priority.

interpretation: Known means already represented as an idea, candidate or source lane, not fully tested. New/new-extension means not already captured at this specificity in this intake review, never original discovery. Queue rows are plans, not experiment results. Multiple variants sharing an engine remain grouped.

counts.followup_count_note: Distinct published records linked by queue results or subsequent_record_ids on already-known intake ideas; parameter settings are not counted.

intake.title: Separate encryption by artwork-defined section.
intake.coverage_note: Artwork sections were profiled statistically; no section-specific cipher/key/reinitialization comparison. Freeze a cipher, candidate keys and section breakpoints.

intake.title: Separate encryption by page.
intake.coverage_note: Opening checks are page-local; compare independent full-page fits against joined-pages fits under the same fixed decoder and score.

intake.title: One continuous stream across pages.
intake.coverage_note: Page joins were audited as word boundaries, not key-continuity rules. Freeze page ordering and a cipher/key before continuous-versus-reset comparison.

intake.title: Smaller reset boundaries.
intake.coverage_note: Feedback census covers page continuity versus word reset only; line/clause/sentence/paragraph/section resets require declared delimiter parsing and a shared decoder.

intake.title: Whole-word or multi-rune encryption.
intake.coverage_note: No whole-word or variable multi-rune encryption transform is specified; state unit mapping, reversibility, key advancement and a target before executable queueing.

intake.title: Word-length skeleton as a plaintext constraint.
intake.coverage_note: Word lengths and page joins were measured, but no fixed dictionary/passage skeleton search with punctuation and joined wraps is recorded. Pin corpus edition and alignment/scoring rule.

intake.title: Alternative plaintext language or spelling.
intake.coverage_note: Eight-language length-profile comparison includes Welsh; not a decryption search under archaic/vowelless/phonetic spelling and GP alias equivalences. Freeze transliteration and corpus.

intake.title: Reapply the demonstrated LP cipher toolkit.
intake.coverage_note: Known direct-toolkit examples and two-key openings do not cover a finite sectionwise Atbash/Caesar/composition grid. Define exact compositions and selection control.

intake.title: Repeating-key Vigenere and related arithmetic.
intake.coverage_note: Two known keys and 43 source wordlist keys have narrow opening checks; longer periods, broader lexicon, reversed text/key and phase-by-section remain outside those scopes.

intake.title: Modified dictionary keys.
intake.coverage_note: The archived 43 wordlist keys did not enumerate systematic one-letter substitutions of candidate keys. Specify source wordlist, replaced rune(s), and whether replacements affect GP multigraphs.

intake.title: Pattern-expanded keys.
intake.coverage_note: No exact rotating/palindromic key expansion record. Freeze endpoint repetition, rotation increment, base-key list, and phase.

intake.title: Alternating alphabets.
intake.coverage_note: Residue-period diagnostics are not an alternating-key decryption. Freeze number of tracks, alphabets, phases and key periods.

intake.title: Keyword-reordered alphabets.
intake.coverage_note: No keyword-mixed alphabet replay. Specify keyword normalization, duplicate handling and whether both cipher and key alphabets are remapped.

intake.title: Grouped Vigenere.
intake.coverage_note: No variable-size grouped Vigenere rule or group schedule. Define group boundaries and key advancement exactly.

intake.title: Affine encryption.
intake.coverage_note: Literal-prime palette closure and observed lag maps do not test periodic affine decryption on rune indices. Freeze multiplier/offset periods and invertibility.

intake.title: Progressive/Alberti-style encryption.
intake.coverage_note: The LP2-39 Alberti branch arithmetic is a specific proposal audit; progressive alphabet-rotation schedules and source key are still needed for a general bounded decryption test.

intake.title: Hill cipher.
intake.coverage_note: Magic-square structural tests are not modular Hill decryption. Freeze 2x2/3x3 matrix candidates, padding, block alignment and mod-29 invertibility.

intake.title: Playfair-style digraph encryption.
intake.coverage_note: Low doublets motivate but do not specify Playfair. Pin 29-symbol digraph grid, merge/filler convention and rectangle/row/column rules.

intake.title: Fractionation.
intake.coverage_note: Coordinate triad is not Bifid/Trifid/Polybius fractionation. Need a 29-symbol coordinate table, period and recombination rule.

intake.title: Substitution beyond individual runes.
intake.coverage_note: Bigram/doublet profiles exist; no bounded digraph/trigraph or homophonic substitution search. Specify alphabet and mapping cardinality, word-boundary policy and language objective.

intake.title: Layered encryption.
intake.coverage_note: Individual key and route tests do not close composition. Select fixed two layers, exact order, keys/routes and held-out criterion.

intake.title: Search the F-interrupter pattern.
intake.coverage_note: All 64 F masks were assessed for one difference recurrence on LP2-54–55; general key-pause interpretation on other sections/ciphers is untested.

intake.title: Generalize the interrupter rune.
intake.coverage_note: Each rune deletion was checked for doublets; no 29-rune candidate interrupter decoding under a fixed key and pause convention.

intake.title: Recover the key from a short prefix first.
intake.coverage_note: Header/prefix feedback checks do not recover a key before first F then predict later interrupts. Requires an independent prefix crib and frozen extension rule.

intake.title: Joint key-and-interrupter search.
intake.coverage_note: Six-F mask enumeration is exact for one recurrence; joint unknown-key plus interruption search needs a fixed key prior, decoder and train/holdout split.

intake.title: Two interpretations of interruption in alternating alphabets.
intake.coverage_note: No source-defined two-alphabet cipher with the two pause semantics. Freeze alternation schedule and key-advance rule.

intake.title: Interrupter locations as a separate message.
intake.coverage_note: F-neighbor and deletion statistics do not decode F position/gap bits. Specify binary coding, ordering, framing and non-post-hoc message criterion.

intake.title: Interrupters as block boundaries.
intake.coverage_note: Boundary doublet checks are not a Lehmer/block-permutation decode. Specify block definition, rank direction, alphabet and incomplete blocks.

intake.title: Additional nulls or padding.
intake.coverage_note: Single-type deletion and source filler edits cover narrow nulls; multiple null classes/word-length correction need insertion/removal model and bounds.

intake.title: Plaintext autokey.
intake.coverage_note: Scalar-primed plaintext feedback lags 1–16 and a distinct cumulative rule are tested; arbitrary seed vectors and key layer are not. Additional source-rule followup tests repeated one-rune primers and 11 fixed prime delays through 31 against nine 12-rune opening guesses; longer delays do not enter feedback in those prefixes.

intake.title: Ciphertext autokey.
intake.coverage_note: Scalar-primed ciphertext feedback lags 1–16 are checked at fixed page openings; larger primers, other positions and key layers remain. Additional source-rule followup tests repeated one-rune primers and 11 fixed prime delays through 31 against nine 12-rune opening guesses; longer delays do not enter feedback in those prefixes. A separate weighted-ciphertext followup covers all 52 pages omitted by its three-page source baseline, under the original constant-seed coefficient grid; varying-key skips remain open.

intake.title: Gematria-feedback autokey.
intake.coverage_note: Generated prime/totient keys and index-feedback tests exist; a previous ciphertext or plaintext GP-prime feedback recurrence needs its exact reduction/update rule.

intake.title: Cumulative feedback.
intake.coverage_note: One literal cumulative recurrence and seven fixed history functions have been replayed; other running GP-prime sum feedback needs a defined state transition.

intake.title: Recover an unknown feedback function using cribs.
intake.coverage_note: No unknown lookup-table inference with contradiction tracking from predeclared cribs. Freeze table domain, allowed ambiguity, training cribs and holdout pages.

intake.title: Difference/integral encoding.
intake.coverage_note: Adjacent differences and one cumulative inversion were tested; multi-layer integral encoding with alternate boundaries requires an exact recurrence.

intake.title: Anti-repeat key switching.
intake.coverage_note: Source collision edits do not test event-driven key switch in a specified cipher. Freeze switch trigger, key list and whether rejected output consumes key.

intake.title: Anti-repeat rejection sampling.
intake.coverage_note: Skip-aware source seed grids exist; no general generator-to-doublet rejection model is identified. Additional variants need exact rejection rule and keyed controls.

intake.title: Residual doublets as clues.
intake.coverage_note: Identity, neighboring differences, placement, residue/parity and boundary contexts are already measured within declared archived-transcription scopes; no causal cipher inferred.

intake.title: Two-track interleaving.
intake.coverage_note: Four-phase periodic statistic is not deinterleaving two plaintext streams. Freeze track period, ordering, cipher per track and evaluation corpus.

intake.title: Prime sequence and prime-minus-one sequence.
intake.coverage_note: Consecutive prime and prime-minus-one opening grids cover fixed start/offset choices; nonunit stride, reverse direction and section restarts are a new bounded extension. A source-derived followup now tests the named numeric streams with conditional key skips, page-local phases 0–4, both signs and Atbash states. Its 50-rune screen selects only some settings for full-page confirmation; see the record for the exact stream subset and limits. A separate followup tests the source-defined page-assigned prime/totient ramps with conditional skips; assignment uses nonempty-segment indices, not always the printed page number.

intake.title: Totient sequences.
intake.coverage_note: Consecutive phi(n) openings and panel arithmetic are tested; phi(prime), iterated and running-sum inputs need separate exact streams. A source-derived followup now tests the named numeric streams with conditional key skips, page-local phases 0–4, both signs and Atbash states. Its 50-rune screen selects only some settings for full-page confirmation; see the record for the exact stream subset and limits. A separate followup tests the source-defined page-assigned prime/totient ramps with conditional skips; assignment uses nonempty-segment indices, not always the printed page number.

intake.title: Primes selected by another sequence.
intake.coverage_note: The exact 16-value LP2-15 panel and Fibonacci shifts are covered; Fibonacci/totient indexed prime and emirp variants require a pinned index convention and bounded starts.

intake.title: Prime gaps and prime indices.
intake.coverage_note: Prime-value sequence tests do not use prime gaps or indices. Specify zero/one-based indexing, start/stride and reductions. A source-derived followup now tests the named numeric streams with conditional key skips, page-local phases 0–4, both signs and Atbash states. Its 50-rune screen selects only some settings for full-page confirmation; see the record for the exact stream subset and limits.

intake.title: Fibonacci-family streams.
intake.coverage_note: A fixed uninterrupted Fibonacci opening search exists; Lucas recurrence and broader initial seeds/reset points are outside it. The fixed all-seed modulo-29 Fibonacci catalog now has a conditional-key-skip followup: exact sign/phase aliases reduce 925,100 source labels to 92,510 canonical 50-rune screens, with complete-page decoding only for screen survivors. Other Fibonacci constructions and alignment rules remain open.

intake.title: Other arithmetic functions and elementary sequences.
intake.coverage_note: Mobius masks/divisor labels and polynomial diagnostics cover only named transforms. Carmichael/Catalan/factorial/etc. are not one test; queue exact small streams with fixed seeds, not a blanket sequence sweep.

intake.title: Mathematical constants.
intake.coverage_note: No pinned digits-of-constants stream test. Freeze decimal expansion/source digits, digit grouping, offset, sign and length. A source-derived followup now tests the named numeric streams with conditional key skips, page-local phases 0–4, both signs and Atbash states. Its 50-rune screen selects only some settings for full-page confirmation; see the record for the exact stream subset and limits.

intake.title: OEIS sequence search.
intake.coverage_note: OEIS search is an unbounded discovery method unless sequence IDs, terms, transforms, offsets and selection correction are frozen; only specific series can enter an executable queue.

intake.title: The LP1 numeric-square function.
intake.coverage_note: LP2-15 square construction and panel stream are covered; transferring abs(3301-p) or prime/totient derivatives as a key to other sections needs a fixed enumeration.

intake.title: Gromark/chain-addition keys.
intake.coverage_note: No Gromark/chain-addition decoding with fixed primer and recurrence. State primer digits, carry/modulus, expansion and reset boundary.

intake.title: Seeded pseudorandom streams.
intake.coverage_note: Seven source-defined PRNGs and typed seed variants have bounded tests; LFSR/Geffe or other named generators need tap and seed conventions before queueing. A source-derived followup now tests the named numeric streams with conditional key skips, page-local phases 0–4, both signs and Atbash states. Its 50-rune screen selects only some settings for full-page confirmation; see the record for the exact stream subset and limits.

intake.title: Historically plausible software generators.
intake.coverage_note: Python-2.7 source front grid is checked; Perl/bash/PHP/.NET/TeX streams need exact implementation versions, seeds and update semantics.

intake.title: Hash-expanded and stretched keys.
intake.coverage_note: One source-defined KDF grid and four payload PRFs are tested; arbitrary Cicada seed/hash chains require precise source byte encoding and iteration schedule.

intake.title: Artifact-derived seeds.
intake.coverage_note: Fixed seed dictionaries and typed seeds exist; additional release-time/PGP/unused-number candidates need provenance and time-zone/byte encoding rules.

intake.title: GP word sums as a key stream.
intake.coverage_note: GP word sums are checked as arithmetic/crib collisions, not as an ordered keystream. Freeze word source, sum-to-index map and reset rule.

intake.title: GP line, sentence, and section totals.
intake.coverage_note: Row prime-sum counts exist; using line/sentence/section totals as key steps needs exact delimiter semantics and reduction.

intake.title: Prime and emirp selection.
intake.coverage_note: Prime/emirp row sums are measured; extracting selected words or sentences into a second stream needs unit selection, ordering and acceptance criterion.

intake.title: Product of GP sentence sums.
intake.coverage_note: Parable GP totals/product are documented; transfer of instar-style sentence-product arithmetic to LP2 requires exact sentences, representation and output mapping.

intake.title: Gematria values as positions.
intake.coverage_note: Specific index inversion/route proposals exist; arbitrary word-sum page/word/rune pointers need explicit index base, wrap rule and target source.

intake.title: Gematria values as movement instructions.
intake.coverage_note: Named routes/movements have bounded replays; other GP-driven movements require a concrete direction table, start, wrap/stop rule and target grid.

intake.title: Work in the prime-value channel before taking mod 29.
intake.coverage_note: Fixed literal-prime palette maps are bounded; multiplication/factorization/digit sums before mod29 is a different, presently unspecified operator family.

intake.title: Separate numerical digit planes.
intake.coverage_note: One source matrix/numeric interpretation is replayed; GP value digit planes across bases need exact padding, endianness and symbol mapping.

intake.title: Entire sections as large integers.
intake.coverage_note: Polynomial recurrence diagnostics are not section packing into large integers. Choose radix, separators/endianness and explicit prime/power/byte predicate.

intake.title: Invert a numerical sum into possible words.
intake.coverage_note: Corpus collisions at four totals are measured; constrained inverse GP-sum enumeration requires a pinned rune lexicon, word lengths and vowel/repetition policy.

intake.title: Solved plaintext as a running key.
intake.coverage_note: External Emerson offsets and two LP keys are checked; solved LP plaintext at successive word starts as running key needs pinned solved-text version and start grid.

intake.title: Solved plaintext with modified rune spellings.
intake.coverage_note: No whole solved-key-text rune replacement sweep. Specify source solved passage and replacement pair(s), retaining exact GP transliteration.

intake.title: Another ciphertext page as the key.
intake.coverage_note: LP2-as-pad tests the reverse direction, not page-on-page ciphertext reuse. Freeze page pairings, alignment, operation and byte/rune XOR semantics.

intake.title: Reverse the key/message roles.
intake.coverage_note: LP2 as a skip-aware key was tested against five pinned objects; other earlier artifacts or alignment rules remain outside that exact record.

intake.title: Acrostics and positional extractions from solved text.
intake.coverage_note: Some initials/layout controls exist for source claims; systematic solved-text initial/final/every-nth extraction needs pinned plaintext, punctuation handling and n-range.

intake.title: Cross-section keyword clues.
intake.coverage_note: Two known keys and 43 wordlist keys do not exhaust the listed cross-section keywords/combinations. Pin exact strings, variant spellings and concatenation order.

intake.title: LP1 magic squares as general key material.
intake.coverage_note: Square construction/perimeter and one LP2 panel stream are documented; LP1 square read orders as direct key/matrix need exact source square and path convention.

intake.title: Hidden diagonal structure in the magic squares. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: 3301/1033 diagonal interpretation is a speculative relationship, not a cipher test. Specify an exact rearrangement and independent predicted value before testing.

intake.title: A separate book cipher.
intake.coverage_note: Historical Emerson coordinates are reproduced; applying page/line/word/letter pointers from LP2 needs a specified external text edition and extraction convention.

intake.title: Previously referenced Cicada literature as running keys.
intake.coverage_note: One pinned Emerson derivative was searched at contiguous offsets on three LP2 pages; Mabinogion/Agrippa/King-in-Yellow/Book-of-Law versions need fixed editions, normalization and same held-out scoring.

intake.title: William Blake as the external-text clue.
intake.coverage_note: Blake cover is a source clue, not a key definition. Identify a specific poem/edition, order/normalization and cipher before running.

intake.title: Jung's Red Book/Liber Novus connection. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Jung thematic similarity is a speculative source lead; no exact passage/edition or extraction/key rule is supplied.

intake.title: Runic and Norse sources.
intake.coverage_note: Rune poems/Eddas/Beowulf/Deor are distinct source-edition candidates; pin text, transliteration and decoder before treating any as a tested key.

intake.title: Religious, occult, and philosophical corpora.
intake.coverage_note: Kabbalistic/Gnostic/Hermetic/alchemical/Thelemic/Taoist corpora are not a finite hypothesis. Select individual text editions/passages and a shared fixed search protocol.

intake.title: Mathematical/scientific reference texts.
intake.coverage_note: Euclid/Newton are source leads; exact text edition and passage, normalization and key/extraction mapping are missing.

intake.title: Cypherpunk writing and manifestos.
intake.coverage_note: Cypherpunk manifesto is a distinct candidate running-key corpus; pin canonical text bytes, case/punctuation normalization, cipher and holdout threshold.

intake.title: Cicada's own signed messages as key text.
intake.coverage_note: Some signed-message words/numbers enter fixed seed grids; whole signed prose as running key needs authenticated message bytes, signature provenance and decoding convention.

intake.title: Fibonacci-indexed Bible references. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Genesis/Fibonacci chapter-verse mapping is speculative; freeze Fibonacci pair start, testament/edition, chapter/verse indexing and a predicted output before testing.

intake.title: Reverse reading direction.
intake.coverage_note: Reverse and boustrophedon routes are already named; tested segment reversals do not exhaust alternation, text layers or composition.

intake.title: Columnar and diagonal transposition.
intake.coverage_note: Column/diagonal route family is already documented; the current sixteen routes do not test arbitrary grid widths or column permutations. Additional public-source keyword followup tests 45 labels /43 effective column orders with dictionary counts, known-reading controls and an explicitly post-target shared-page shuffle comparison; arbitrary permutations remain open.

intake.title: Rail-fence transposition.
intake.coverage_note: The fixed rail-fence replay already records this method. Other rails, segmentation and combined layers require separate bounds.

intake.title: Spiral or perimeter-peeling order.
intake.coverage_note: Spiral and perimeter route ideas are already documented; the Roman digit spiral is only a specific replay, not every rune-grid spiral.

intake.title: Square-length sections as matrices.
intake.coverage_note: The 729-rune opening square and section-matrix proposals are already queued/replayed in limited forms.

intake.title: Mobius-style traversal.
intake.coverage_note: MÃ¶bius/wrapped-grid routing is a known interpretation. A deterministic strip join and read order are still needed; the shared name is not proof the navigation was tested.

intake.title: Prime/Fibonacci-index extraction.
intake.coverage_note: Positional extraction is already documented. Prime/Fibonacci index selection needs a frozen stream, index origin and exclusions before a new bounded run.

intake.title: Page reordering.
intake.coverage_note: Page reordering is already considered. The existing grid permutation test is narrower; this catalog gives no new complete order.

intake.title: Page superimposition.
intake.coverage_note: Image overlays and alignment are known leads. A shared artwork match is not a text-mask decoder; specify page pair, registration and readout. Separate arithmetic followups align rune streams at forward relative shifts with at least 120-rune overlap, using difference IoC and fixed English-scored sums/differences. These do not test image masking or registered pixel overlays.

intake.title: Layout counts as a separate stream.
intake.coverage_note: Line-fill, word counts and page geometry as a separate channel already have source entry B-12; do not duplicate it or treat the histogram checks as a decoding test.

intake.title: Delimiter and ornament encoding.
intake.coverage_note: Spacing/delimiter bit-channel proposal is already queued. Need an image-level symbol inventory and fixed binary/ternary mapping.

intake.title: 27x27 mirrored-triplet navigation. [disputed solution claim]
intake.coverage_note: The supplied 27x27 mirrored-triplet method already has a dedicated replay; its proposed plaintext remains unverified.

intake.title: Matching artwork implies matching cipher treatment.
intake.coverage_note: Artwork-to-method interpretation is already retained. It needs a particular transferred rule, not general thematic resemblance.

intake.title: Branches and roots encode a sequence.
intake.coverage_note: Retain explicit Fibonacci/branch-graph counting as a candidate beyond image reuse and the LP2-39 arithmetic audit. Need annotated branch junctions, roots/tips and a fixed traversal; count the full allowed tree set on controls.

intake.title: Mayfly means an ephemeral key. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Ephemeral/one-use key interpretation of the mayfly adds an explicit semantic lead. No key construction, target or falsifiable prediction is supplied.

intake.title: Tree of life / tree of knowledge. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Tree-of-life/knowledge symbolism belongs to the existing interpretation/reference research, not a new specified cipher. No exact text or operation is selected.

intake.title: Cuneiform gives the number system.
intake.coverage_note: Base-60 interpretation and conditional byte constraints are already documented; this is not a new decoding experiment.

intake.title: Constellation interpretation of the dots. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Orion geometry was already retained; add the explicitly named Aquila and Bootes candidates to that comparison, with a fixed star catalog/epoch/projection and full candidate-search controls.

intake.title: Geographic or celestial map. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Map/coordinate readings already exist. The turtle-path replay is one rule, not proof against arbitrary geographic or celestial interpretations.

intake.title: Repeated dead-oak imagery selects a starting point. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Repeated-tree provenance and proposed cipher relevance already separated. Prioritizing a section from shared imagery supplies no new transform.

intake.title: True/false paths as dark/light shading. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Explicit dark-versus-light true/false path reading is not captured by the contrast tools alone. Need original illustrated path, reproducible mask, branch choices and readout; never select shading after seeing words.

intake.title: Recover the source artwork.
intake.coverage_note: Source-artwork comparison is an established research lane; keep source identity, image transform and claimed cipher relevance separate.

intake.title: Marginal dots as musical notes. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: A notation family is documented but the specific marginal-dot-to-note readout is not a recorded experiment. Freeze dot coordinates, staff, reading order and note-to-rune mapping.

intake.title: Gregorian/square notation. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Add the specific Gregorian/square-notation staff alternative to the same dot-music queue item, with staff count, clef and solfege interpretation fixed in advance.

intake.title: Constellations arranged as a score. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: The composite constellation-to-score route adds distinct choices; track with dot-music, requiring a fixed constellation registration and score mapping before reading outputs.

intake.title: Earlier Cicada music as key material.
intake.coverage_note: Earlier audio/music as keys already appears in the music and watermark proposals. The narrowband measurement does not test arbitrary musical key extraction.

intake.title: Decode the pairs as base-60 values/bytes.
intake.coverage_note: Conditional base-60 byte conversion is already established and reproduced under specific transcription choices.

intake.title: Alternative digit alphabets or bases.
intake.coverage_note: Alternative bases/digit orders are a documented family; base59 versus60 has a bounded reconciliation. No new order is specified by this generic list.

intake.title: First character is a group label.
intake.coverage_note: Treat the first digit as a class label and emit second-character streams per class. Existing 4-prefix statistics do not decode all five suffix channels; freeze order, alphabet and recombination.

intake.title: Group 4 supplies a key. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: The existing record confirms suffix string 97DEF756B98A80EB9 but does not use it as a key. It has 17 hex nibbles, not an integral byte length: choose and justify packing/padding, algorithm and target before testing.

intake.title: Payload as the runic text's key.
intake.coverage_note: Payload-as-key and PRF-seed branches are already queued and partly replayed; fixed openings/English-score bounds do not close all direct-pad or repeated-key uses. A source-defined conditional-skip followup tests two payload readings and their reversals at the exact page-dependent phases; the short-screen selection and beam width differ from the older zero-offset test.

intake.title: Payload as several hashes.
intake.coverage_note: Retain explicit splitting of the 256 bytes into digest-sized blocks and matching a frozen candidate-input corpus. Specify block lengths/offsets, algorithms and complete comparison count.

intake.title: Payload related to the AN END hash.
intake.coverage_note: Payload/key/hash-preimage branches already exist in the source-blob matrix and page56 preimage work. No new byte transform is fixed here.

intake.title: Payload as an encrypted file/container.
intake.coverage_note: Headers, packet/container and keyed encryption branches already tracked. Current byte-zero headers and tag11 checks are limited, not a general encrypted-container exclusion.

intake.title: Payload as an RSA-related number.
intake.coverage_note: RSA/modulus/ciphertext interpretations already tracked, with a narrower 54-byte-window replay complete.

intake.title: Payload as a bitmap or QR-like object.
intake.coverage_note: The same bitmap/barcode idea is already queued. The 64-bit rendering result is not evidence about other widths, padding or finder patterns.

intake.title: Payload under XOR or bytewise encryption.
intake.coverage_note: XOR, reversed blobs and external symmetric keys already belong to the source-blob battery; no duplicate queue item for this generic restatement.

intake.title: Numerical pair labels as directions. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Leading 0â€“4 values as route instructions is distinct from suffix statistics. Track with prefix-split channels; freeze five-state direction table, origin, boundary handling and readout.

intake.title: Isolate red text.
intake.coverage_note: Red headings/initials as separate targets already form multiple records. Counts of large initials are not a transcription of all red prose.

intake.title: The long red passage on page 53.
intake.coverage_note: Add LP2-53 long red passage as a specific independent target. Verify the claimed51 runes from original image, delimit the exact span, then freeze cipher/key phases and interrupter masks.

intake.title: Red-text gematria links. [speculative]
intake.coverage_note: Retain the specific LP2-23 red-sum691 / TEST THE KNOWLEDGE claim for arithmetic and encoding audit. Need the source post, exact red rune range and rune encoding; a numerical match alone is not an instruction.

intake.title: Brightness, contrast, and color separation.
intake.coverage_note: Brightness/contrast/RGB separation are existing inspection tools. No new carrier, extraction rule or prediction is specified.

intake.title: OutGuess with candidate passwords.
intake.coverage_note: Extend known password-attack work from the earlier onion chain to exact LP2 original carriers and a frozen LP-word key list. Default-key results do not cover this.

intake.title: Other image-steganography methods.
intake.coverage_note: Track steghide and explicit JPEG/DCT/bit-channel tools on LP2 carriers in the same stego task. Need versioned extraction rules, a finite key/channel list and planted format-specific controls.

intake.title: Appended data, metadata, and embedded files.
intake.coverage_note: Appended bytes, metadata and embedded payload inspection already documented in the extraction/provenance work. Do not infer exhaustive absence from one inspected field.

intake.title: Glyph shape and placement as bits.
